database.name: SellTech AI Graphics Cards
database.enrichmentPolicy: Add missing source-reported values only; see per-product enrichmentProvenance. Original benchmarkDate does not date imported metrics.
database.vramEnrichmentPolicy: Only primary-confirmed exact-model capacities added; configuration-dependent records retain no scalar VRAM. See vramVerification and gpu_vram_web_audit.json.
database.firstFiveEnrichmentPolicy: Only absent values added. Physical values refer to the identified reference board, not all retail variants. bracketType is native board mounting-height class, not installed bracket inventory. sffReady evidence distinguishes vendor-documented SFF form factor from GeForce certification and never guarantees every case. Relative performance is a Steel Nomad synthetic index, not average game FPS. Original benchmarkDate does not date these additions. See per-field webResearchRounds provenance.
database.coverageEnrichmentPolicy: Add only missing values in fields with original coverage 80.4–99.4%; preserve all original product values. Source scope, API support subset, metric semantics, and superseded absence annotations are retained in per-field provenance. ZIP/GitHub agreement is not independent primary verification.
database.extendedEnrichmentPolicy: Only missing primary-confirmed values added. Existing values preserved. Manufacturer reference dimensions/connectors are not universal retail-variant specifications; exact board check required. No invented performance scores; original benchmarkDate does not date these additions. Community/ZIP data used for discovery, not independent primary proof.

rules.nullPolicy: Fields without a concrete value are omitted.
rules.knownAbsencePolicy: Known NOT_APPLICABLE / NOT_SUPPORTED / variant-dependent states are preserved in dataAvailability when they carry recommendation meaning.
rules.unknownPolicy: UNKNOWN/unverified placeholders are not emitted as product values.
rules.softScoring: Missing SOFT data is excluded from the available score denominator and may reduce confidence.
rules.pricing: No static market price is fabricated; pricingLookup only stores lookup/configuration metadata.
rules.performance: Only captured benchmark/performance values are emitted; missing values are never fabricated.
rules.determinism: Same database version and same answers must produce the same eligibility/ranking.
